description: Canonical terms vectors for blueprint 2.6. Rust (contracts/openrail/src/terms.rs) and TypeScript (services/api) must reproduce every expected_canonical and expected_sha256 byte for byte.
canonicalization: JSON object whose keys are sorted at every level, UTF-8, no whitespace. Strings use JSON escaping (quote, backslash, short escapes for \b \f \n \r \t, \u00XX for other control characters); non-ASCII is emitted as UTF-8, not \u escapes. sha256 is over the canonical UTF-8 bytes.
notes: amount_usd is always a JSON string with exactly two decimals (blueprint 2.6: integer money as strings).
assignment_agreement_sha256 is omitted from the canonical JSON when the input field is absent; it is never null.
clauses keep the input order: core clauses first, then module clauses.
